events.body: Change Forkmesh from a patch-to-main PR model to an isolated PR-ref model. Incoming fork submissions should create/update refs/pr/<id>/head or a review-side repo ref, not modify main or apply patches into pulls/ as pending main changes. Keep PR metadata in the DB while in transit similar to how we store issues (then pull to the source of truth), allow review/edit/CI against the PR ref, preserve main as protected source of truth, and only update main when the PR is explicitly approved and merged.
events.title: update the PR system

events.body:
```
Change Forkmesh from a patch-to-main PR model to an isolated PR-ref model. Incoming fork submissions should create/update refs/pr/<id>/head or a review-side repo ref, not modify main or apply patches into pulls/ as pending main changes. Keep PR metadata in the DB, allow review/edit/CI against the PR ref, preserve main as protected source of truth, and only update main when the PR is explicitly approved and merged.

```
